intro
This is Inkflow, an infinite canvas whiteboard with a hand drawn look, built from scratch. Your workspace keeps recent boards, projects, favorites and templates together.
draw
Let's create a board. Shapes are drawn with a seeded, sketchy style, so they look identical on every device and in every export.
style
The properties panel controls stroke and fill colors, hachure or solid fills, stroke width, dashes and sloppiness.
text
Text is edited inline, and freehand strokes are smooth, pressure aware vectors.
connect
Connectors are semantic. They bind to shapes and ports, and reroute automatically when a node moves. Every drag is a single undo step.
library
The library has over a hundred technical symbols and twenty five editable templates, from microservices to O Auth flows.
mermaid
You can also paste Mermaid text and get a real, editable diagram, then tidy it with automatic layout.
diagrams
Diagrams go deep: architecture maps with obstacle avoiding routing, and E R diagrams with crow's foot relationships.
collab
Collaboration is real time. A teammate joins through a share link, and you see their cursor and edits live. Offline changes are queued and synced when the connection returns.
comments
Comments pin to the canvas or to elements, with replies, mentions and resolve.
versions
Every board autosaves to PostgreSQL, with automatic and manual version history you can restore.
export
Export to P N G, vector S V G, P D F or JSON, for the whole board, a selection or a single frame.
present
Frames become slides in presentation mode, with keyboard navigation and a laser pointer.
outro
And there's a full dark mode. That's Inkflow.
